name: dap-portal
comment: The sample-data layer is the brand catalogue, not a marker-string fixture set: with sampleData true this edition carries 97 product rows across 16 groups, the three personas on account TC-100200 and the twelve orders, which is what the Product Assets and Search results surfaces list. expectedCounts is pinned rather than derived because Set-ConfigFromEdition derives EcomProducts/EcomGroups from the toggle alone and carries the pre-4.0.0 figures. OPEN POINT, carried and not resolved here: the layer also ships merge/_content storefront copy authored at surface-swift's own paths under 'Swift 2'. This edition composes surface-dap-portal (area 26) and no Swift 2 content area, so those documents are expected to be inert - the Foundry gate is what proves it, and until a run says so this comment is the record that nobody has measured it.
description: Digital Asset Portal edition: framework-only base + sample data + the Digital Assets Portal content surface (area 26, ~32 pages on Swift-v2 item types - the item-type definitions come from the host's Swift design-package overlay, not from base content). Proven on DW 10.28.1-PreRelease.
